description: 17-stage operating model for Autonomous Lead Discovery and Qualification Mission

stages.name: Owner Goal Intake
stages.description: Parse and validate owner goal. Confirm no fixed artifact list injected.

stages.name: CEO Mission Interpretation
stages.description: CEO interprets the lead-gen goal, defines strategic context and success criteria.

stages.name: Department Briefing
stages.description: COO briefs all 9 departments on mission scope, hard locks, and allowed actions.

stages.name: Department Artifact Proposals
stages.description: Each department proposes what artifacts they believe are needed, with rationale.

stages.name: Cross-Department Negotiation
stages.description: COO facilitates negotiation to resolve overlaps, merge duplicate proposals, and confirm ownership.

stages.name: Artifact Manifest Creation
stages.description: COO finalizes self-selected artifact manifest with owning department and rationale for each item.

stages.name: Worker Assignment
stages.description: COO assigns specific worker agents to each artifact.

stages.name: Artifact Generation
stages.description: Each department generates its assigned artifacts. Demo lead data must be clearly labeled as demo.

stages.name: QA Review
stages.description: QA reviews all artifacts against acceptance criteria. Blocks weak or incomplete output.

stages.name: Gap Analysis
stages.description: QA runs gap analysis. All critical gaps must be closed before proceeding.

stages.name: Gap Closure
stages.description: Departments close all critical gaps identified by QA.

stages.name: Final Packaging
stages.description: COO creates final package index, artifact manifest, and decision log.

stages.name: KPI Scoring
stages.description: CFO scores mission KPIs: lead count, qualification rate, pipeline value estimate, time-to-ready.

stages.name: CLO Learning Update
stages.description: CLO/Hermes appends lessons learned to memory/ai-company/mission-lessons.jsonl.

stages.name: Paperclip Update
stages.description: CTO generates Paperclip department update payload.

stages.name: Auto Verification
stages.description: QA runs automated verifier script to confirm all checks pass.

stages.name: Pre-Merge Simulation
stages.description: QA runs premerge simulation to verify safety, compliance, and integration with all prior milestones.
